items.content_html:
Welcome! I’m Tomtom, and this site is my personal top 5 list of favorite games. Each one has a short background, a plot summary, and my review. Scroll down to see the full ranking, or click any game to read more.

The Ranking

#1 Genshin Impact: A huge fantasy world full of exploration, elemental combat, and great music.

#2 Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain: Stealth gameplay with freedom to tackle every mission your own way.

#3 Wuthering Waves: Fast, stylish combat in a post-apocalyptic world.

#4 Ghost of Tsushima: A gorgeous samurai story with cinematic duels.

#5 Arknights: Endfield: Squad combat mixed with factory building on a new frontier planet.
